subject: Next steps: Procurement & billing details for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@brightwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps on the procurement/billing side so we can keep momentum for the pilot: 

- Billing path: can you confirm whether BrightWave will route via PO (preferred by procurement) or pay by card for the pilot?
- Net terms: do you have a standard (Net 30 / Net 45)?
- Invoice requirements: preferred invoice format (PDF / XLS), required line-item granularity, and any tax/VAT fields you need.
- Bill-to & remit-to: full legal billing name and address we should use on invoice.
- Marketplace interest: are you interested in purchasing via AWS/GCP marketplace or would you prefer a direct contract?

I've attached a draft SOW and a sample quote for the pilot so procurement can see line items and amounts. If you can send over the billing contact and any vendor onboarding checklist, I'll loop Legal/Finance on our side and produce an official quote/SOW for signature.

Planned follow-ups: we can prepare a PO-friendly invoice (separate PDF with line items + tax breakdown) and a DocuSign-ready SOW if that helps expedite approvals.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: SOW_Redwood_Pilot_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: Evan Park <evan.park@brightwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@brightwave.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Procurement here prefers PO + Net 30 for pilot engagements. A few specifics from our side: 

- Invoice format: PDF invoice with a separate XLS invoice template (we attach our finance template for line-item mapping).
- Required fields: vendor legal name, vendor tax ID / EIN, invoice number, invoice date, line-item qty/unit/price, subtotal, taxes (if any), total, and our PO number when issued.
- Billing / remit-to: BrightWave Analytics, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1201 Market St, Suite 240, San Francisco, CA 94103. Email for invoice delivery: finance@brightwave.com.
- Tax/VAT: No VAT for US-based entities; if Redwood has foreign entities, we may need VAT breakdown.
- Vendor onboarding: please provide a W-9 and vendor legal name for our system.

Marketplace: Procurement prefers a direct contract for now (marketplace listings add additional procurement steps), but the team is open to revisiting after pilot.

We'll aim to issue a PO once Legal signs off — timeline is ~10 business days from receipt of vendor docs & final quote.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Park
Senior Procurement Manager | BrightWave Analytics
evan.park@brightwave.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
[Attachment: BrightWave_Invoice_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@brightwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Evan —

Perfect, that's very helpful. Next steps on our side: 

- I'll get a vendor packet (W-9 + vendor legal name + Redwood tax ID) over to you by EOD.
- Neha will produce a formal quote that matches your invoice template (line items + totals) and indicate Net 30 terms.
- We'll attach a DocuSign-friendly SOW so Legal can sign quickly; if you prefer countersign via DocuSign we can do that.

One question — does BrightWave require any specific PO reference on the invoice header (e.g., "PO# to be added after issuance") or is it fine to issue invoice without PO and include the PO number later?

Also tagging Neha and Vivek internally to coordinate the quote and legal paperwork.

Thanks,

Marissa
[Attachment: Redwood_Quote_2026-02_BrightWave.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: BrightWave billing / quote action items

Neha / Vivek — quick internal note to prepare the deliverables for BrightWave: 

- Create final quote using attached draft (see HubSpot deal BRW-984321 for list prices). Include Net 30 payment terms and line-items as in the attached BrightWave template.
- Include Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Tax ID: 82-1234567; Remit-to address: 1200 Redwood Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
- Produce two invoice outputs: (1) PO-friendly PDF and (2) XLS that maps to BrightWave template.
- Prepare W-9 to attach to vendor packet.
- Timeline: aim to send to Evan by EOD today so they can start Legal review.

Link to deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BRW-984321

-Marissa

From: Evan Park <evan.park@brightwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@brightwave.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. PO workflow is fine with issuing the PO after we receive the vendor packet and final quote; please include the vendor tax ID on the quote. Our finance team prefers the PO to be referenced on the invoice header once issued, but it's okay to issue the invoice first and have the PO number applied afterward (we'll annotate).

We generally accept signed SOWs via DocuSign. Expect the PO in ~10 business days after we receive the final paperwork. I'll loop in our Finance lead (Sofia) for delivery.

Best,
Evan
[No attachments]
